findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION FROM INSPECTION DATED 5/12/2021.

The strainer is back in the hand sink from the previous inspection. The strainer was previously removed but has since been allowed to be used to facilitate dumping in the hand sink. Hand sinks may only be used for hand washing, never dumping, and must remain unblocked by any items to be accessible to staff at all times. Hand sinks MAY NEVER be used for dumping and items MAY NEVER be stored in the hand sink. Ensure that the hand sink is accessible at all times of operation. A follow-up is issued for 01/08/2024 to determine if facility is in compliance with this requirement. 

5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Mold is observed int he soda gun holder with the soda gun nozzle stored in it. Although the soda gun holder is a nonfood-contact surface requiring less frequent cleaning, the soda gun nozzle is a food-contact surface and requires frequent cleaning and sanitization to prevent contamination of foods served to consumers. Ensure that the soda gun holder and soda gun are cleaned and sanitized and remain as such. Additionally, the white upright freezer at the bar used to store glasses has a large accumulation of ice on the shelves. Operator states that this freezer is manually defrosted on a weekly basis and it cannot be defrosted daily. Inspector instructed operator to store glasses in the freezer with the lips of the glasses out of the ice to prevent contamination of this food-contact surface. However, operator must keep in mind that if these glasses are stored face up and ice is allowed to accumulate above them, this constitutes a violation as well because food-contact surfaces must be stored in a manner that protects from contamination. It is recommended that facility replace the freezer to ensure future compliance. A follow-up is issued for 01/02/2024 to determine compliance with food-contact surface cleaning and sanitization. 

4-602.11: (D) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned less than every 4 hours if in storage of food within proper temperatures, food is prepared in refrigerated room, if practice has regulatory approval, or UTENSILS stored in 135F water. (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Inspector observed a mop stored in the lower portion of a mop bucket with soiled mop water. Mops must be stored in a manner that facilitates air drying and prevents contamination. Mops may be stored in the top portion of the mop bucket OR hanging inverted along a wall. Ensure that mops are stored properly at all times and that mop water is immediately dumped and removed from the facility once soiled. 

6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: A strainer was observed to be stored in the hand washing sink. It was stated this was used for catching debris when dumping drinks down the drain. The strainer was removed and placed in the triple sink to clear up the hand sink. Ensure this practice continues to keep the hand sink readily accessible and clear for hand washing.
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
3-304.11: A beer was observed to be stored in the ice machine behind the bar that is used for making drinks. The beer was removed and placed in the appropriate cooler. Ensure the ice bin remains clear of any items besides ice and the scoop used to obtain the ice when not in storage.
3-304.11: (A) FOOD shall only contact surfaces of EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS that are cleaned. (B) SINGLE-SERVICE/USE ARTICLES (C) LINENS

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
1) Observed the ice deflector in the ice machine to have a spot on the left side where it appears mold is growing. 2) Observed the nozzle of the soda gun to be soiled. A small brush may be needed to clean this out. Wash, rinse and sanitize these food contact surfaces.
750-800d Food-contact surfaces of grills, griddles, and similar cooking devices and the cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least once a day.   The food-contact surfaces of all cooking equipment shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other accumulated soil.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
1) Observed the drip trays of the pizza oven to be soiled with food debris and char. 2) Observed the bag in box soda rack area as well as the hoses to be soiled with possibly mold or syrup accumulation in the basement. Clean these non0food contact surfaces.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: No Certified Manager Present
findings.comment:
No proof of current certified food manager. Kevin has Food Handler Training but there needs to be a full time employee who has the certified food manager 8 hour course. In January, the person in charge at the time of the inspection will be required to have this certification. Provide inspector with proof of successful completion of this course.
750-540 All Category II facilities must have at least one full-time Licensed Food Service Sanitation Manager employed at the facility to help ensure proper food handling.  Provide at least one fulltime Food Service Sanitation Manager.

findings.comment:

750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
REPEAT- The three compartment sink was separated from the wall. Seal sink to the wall.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment: Chlorine test strips are available in the facility but they are using quat sanitizer in the 3 part sink and do not have quat sanitizer test strips available in the facility. 750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million. Provide Quat sanitizer test strips.

findings.title: Sanitizing concentration
findings.comment: Sanitizing solution in the 3 part sink at the bar is between 100 and 150ppm of quat sanitizer. 750-820d Equipment and utensils shall be sanitized in the third compartment according to one of the methods included in section 750.820 (e) (1) through (4). Immersion for one minute in a clean solution containing at least 200ppm of quat sanitizer. Another sanitab was added to the sink and the solution is now 200ppm.

findings.comment: The following unnecessary articles are observed in the facility: 1) roasters 2) crock pots 3) large containers of seasoning 4) blocks of velveta cheese 5) cans of rotel. 750-1350c Only articles necessary for the operation and maintenance of the food service establishment shall be stored on the premises.  Remove al other unnecessary items. Some items such as frozen sausage and meat in the facility are personal use (belong to the owner) according to owner/management and are not served to the public.
